text:
An opensource personal expense tracker, I was a happy user from an offline expense tracker which wiped my data when playstore decided auto-updating it,

I'm at the point where I'm finally actively using it to register my activity, it is straightforward to register tickets by sending them to a telegram bot, then, reconcile those by uploading my bank statement.

I'm trying to get the lowest possible usage friction so that I keep using it.

So far the better built pieces related to the data ingestion. Once this is good enough I'll build reports + anything coming to my head as a useful piece.

I'm leveraging AWS textract + bedrock + bda to parse bank statements. I expected this would have been easier but it is still a very complex problem which had required me to put many iterations (so far it works nicely with my own statements)

For ticket parsing, AWS textract + parsing rules has been enough.

I wrote a bit more on my blog https://alexitc.com/blog/2026-10-16-opensourcing-my-expense-...

Repo at https://github.com/AlexITC/expense-tracker/
